svg.title: UML basic arrow types reference
svg.desc: A visual cheat sheet showing the six standard UML relationship arrows: inheritance, realization, dependency, association, aggregation, and composition.
svg.text: Solid line, hollow triangle. Subclass points to superclass.
Dashed line, hollow triangle. Class points to interface.
Dashed line, open arrow. User points to the thing it uses.
Solid line, open arrow. A persistent reference between objects.
Solid line, hollow diamond on the whole. Parts can outlive the whole.
Solid line, filled diamond on the whole. Parts die with the whole.
